uncited: *   **Stuck Bug:** Checking collision against the *current* cell causes permanent sticking if the player starts inside a wall.
*   **Corner Penetration:** Simple axis checks might allow corners to clip into walls if not validated properly.
A collision check variant that tests all four corners of the player box on both axis moves to prevent overlap.
Uses AABB swept against the voxel grid with per-axis snap-to-contact collision resolution and auto step-up over 1-voxel lips.
Ground friction is applied, and jump uses fixed-speed so lower gravity results in higher apex and longer hang time.
